title: 2027 Seoul Marathon — Korean domestic registration schedule and rules
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: Domestic record submission runs 28 April 10:00 to 11 May 15:00 2026 via runarchive.com; valid records were held between 1 January 2024 and 10 May 2026; one record per runner; park runs are excluded.
Priority registration runs 18 May 10:00 to 22 May 15:00 2026 via the Dongma Club.
Main domestic registration opens 1 June (A 19:00, B 20:00, C 21:00, D 22:00) and 2 June (E 19:00, F 20:00, G 21:00, H 22:00), first-come; the 10K opens 3 June 19:00.
The full course is 42.195 km; the qualifying full-marathon record must be within 4:59:59; the domestic entry fee is not stated on this notice.
The domestic refund deadline is 30 November 2026 14:00 KST; entries cannot be transferred or resold; a substitute runner is disqualified.
